List vouchers (sales invoices, receipts, payments, credit/debit notes) with pagination, date range, search, and optional JSON filters in the request body. Pass type, page, count, dates, sort, and search on the query string; send VoucherFilter fields in the JSON body. Part of the Get All APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of vouchers per page). Default: 25.

from.description: Start of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with to.

to.description: End of voucher date range (dd-MM-yyyy). Used with from.

type.description: Which voucher list to load. Required — without a supported type the API returns no rows or INVALID_PARAMETER. Allowed values: sales, invoice, payment, receipt, credit note, debit note. Default: invoice.

sort.description: Sort direction for sortBy. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: voucherDate, dueDate, voucherNumber. Default: voucherDate.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint used for sales/invoice lists (backend default 10). Default: 10.

q.description: Case-sensitive search on account name, account uniqueName, or voucher number.

branchUniqueName.description: Limit to a branch. Omit for company default / consolidated behaviour.

accountUniqueName.description: Filter to a single customer/vendor account uniqueName.

balanceStatus.description: Filter by balance status. Send one or more values. Allowed values: PAID, UNPAID, PARTIALLY PAID, CANCEL, OVERDUE.

status.description: Filter by e-invoice / voucher status codes (when applicable for the type).

voucherNumber.description: Exact or partial voucher number filter.

balanceDue.description: Amount to compare when balanceMoreThan, balanceLessThan, or balanceEqual is true.

balanceMoreThan.description: When true, balanceDue is a lower bound.

balanceLessThan.description: When true, balanceDue is an upper bound.

dueDateBefore.description: When true, dueDate is an upper bound.

dueDateAfter.description: When true, dueDate is a lower bound.

invoiceDateBefore.description: When true, invoiceDate is an upper bound.

invoiceDateAfter.description: When true, invoiceDate is a lower bound.

total.description: Grand total amount when totalMoreThan/LessThan/Equal flags are used.

totalMoreThan.description: Compare grand total greater than total.

totalLessThan.description: Compare grand total less than total.

totalEqual.description: Compare grand total equal to total.

groupUniqueName.description: Limit to accounts in this account group.

companyName.description: Optional company display name filter (export/report flows).

copyTypes.description: Voucher copy types for export/mail flows. Allowed values: ORIGINAL, CUSTOMER, TRANSPORT.

sendTo.description: Email recipients when bulk export/mail is triggered from filter.
